_note: Central, configurable definition of automatic ORDER-LEVEL discounts (task spec §5 + discount precedence). The database/config is the single source of truth — rules are NEVER hardcoded across components. Amounts are in AED and compared against the eligible order subtotal (sum of final, VAT-inclusive line totals). Thresholds are STRICTLY GREATER THAN. Precedence: the highest-priority QUALIFYING rule wins and NO tiers stack — an over-200 discount-requested order gets 20% (not 20% on top of 15%). The 20% tier only applies when the customer explicitly asked for a discount (requires_discount_request=true).

rules.name: Order value over AED 100
rules.description: 15% off automatically when the eligible order subtotal is over AED 100.

rules.name: Discount-requested order value over AED 200
rules.description: 20% off when the customer explicitly asked for a discount AND the eligible order subtotal is over AED 200. Replaces (does not stack with) the 15% tier.
